messages:
incident-bot: ALERT 🔔 smart-routing detected repeated fallbacks for customer traffic -> potential routing deadlock. metric: routing.fallbacks_per_min > 50 for 3m. affected region: eu-west-1. models implicated: rdw-neo-7b-int8 (quantized, no toolcall), rdw-neo-7b-fp16 (toolcall ok).

ivy-oncall: Acknowledged. I'm taking pager. Initial impact?

ryan-sre: seeing ~2000 requests/min hit smart-route policy. Policy tries local quantized variant first (int8), gets rapid codec/toolcall errors (missing toolhook), then falls back to fp16 in eu-west, but fallback policy prefers cheaper variant resulting in oscillation. logs: ```[2026-03-15T12:34:10Z] route_decision: variant=rdw-neo-7b-int8 status=fail reason=toolcall_unsupported; fallback->rdw-neo-7b-fp16 region=eu-west-1; later route->rdw-neo-7b-int8 region=eu-central-1```

mike-runtime: Confirmed. The compatibility matrix in model catalog lacked the `tool_calling: true/false` flag for the quantized int8 artifacts. Smart-routing uses that matrix for routing constraints. Missing flag treated as 'compatible' by default -> bad.

emily-support: Customer-facing note: Support observed errors in 3 Dedicated customers in EU region (conversational tool integrations failing). They reported increased 5xx rates and a few timeouts. Escalated to account teams.

ivy-oncall: Quick mitigation plan: 1) disable region fallback for the affected policy (circuit-breaker style) 2) mark rdw-neo-7b-int8 as toolcall_unsupported in model registry 3) rollout a guarded routing policy that respects explicit compat flags. I will run step 1 now.

ryan-sre: Commands to flip policy (admin API):
```bash
# disable region-level fallback on policy smart-route-eu
curl -s -X PATCH https://admin.internal.redwood/v1/policies/smart-route-eu -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -d '{"allow_region_fallback": false}'
```

ivy-oncall: Ran the PATCH, got 200. Smart-route-eu now has allow_region_fallback=false. Monitoring: fallbacks_per_min dropped from ~60 -> ~4 within 30s.

deploy-bot: PERFORM: policy-update smart-route-eu by ivy-oncall at 2026-03-15T12:36:01Z status=success

mike-runtime: Next we should mark the artifact metadata. Ryan, can you push a metadata patch to model-registry? Example payload: ```json
{"model":"rdw-neo-7b-int8","compat":{"tool_calling":"false","max_context_tokens":2048}}
```

ryan-sre: Pushed metadata patch and invalidated routing cache. Command: `POST /v1/models/rdw-neo-7b-int8/metadata` payload applied. Confirmed via registry API: tool_calling=false now present.

emily-support: Notifying affected customers with a brief summary and ETA for full fix. Will attach incident ticket numbers.

sophia-engmgr: Thanks team. This looks like a gap in the onboarding flow for quantized artifacts. Action items: 1) add a model-registry validation check that rejects artifacts lacking explicit compat flags; 2) add end-to-end unit test in smart-routing that simulates toolcall-required requests against int8 variants; 3) update runbook to include circuit-breaker for region fallbacks.

ivy-oncall: Handoff: I'm handing to @ryan-sre for follow-up and deeper root cause work. On-call shift ends in 50m. Ryan, please continue monitoring and triage.

ryan-sre: Acknowledged, taking over. Current status: mitigated (fallback oscillation reduced). Customer-impact: brief error spikes for 3 customers, degraded latency for ~20k requests over 12m window. No data loss.

mike-runtime: Temporary follow-up patch planned: treat missing compat flags as conservative (incompatible) and add telemetry to surface mismatches in a dashboard. I'll open PR and tag @sophia-engmgr for prioritization.

emily-support: Tickets sent to accounts + internal postmortem stub opened: INC-2359123456.cs-note.

ivy-oncall: Quick checklist I've executed: updated policy, patched registry metadata, alerted customers, escalated. Leaving logs + commands in thread.

ryan-sre: Logs/diagnostics attached below for postmortem team (snippets):
```
# aggregated error types (12:30-12:42 UTC)
toolcall_unsupported: 1,842
routing_retry_loop_detected: 74
latency_p95_increase: +220ms
```

sophia-engmgr: Adding these follow-ups to roadmap: model-registry validation, routing compatibility unit tests, runbook update, add telemetry alert for 'compatibility-matrix-missing-flag'.

ivy-oncall: Anything else before I drop out?

emily-support: I'll continue customer comms until resolved. No further escalations yet.

ryan-sre: Will keep monitoring for 2h, then hand to next oncall per rotation. Opening postmortem ticket: PM-2359123456. Proposed severity: Sev3 (customer service disruption limited to small set).

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated -> monitoring. next update scheduled in 60m or on status change.
